purpose: Keep a first successful observation after Blocked in Recovering/E until explicit stability criteria are satisfied.

evidence_boundary.motivation: Within the public capture, B->E->B occurred 8/8 times and B->E->H 0/8 times.
evidence_boundary.claim_ceiling: This supports hysteresis within the capture; it does not identify a provider limiter or establish universal recovery thresholds.

invariants: The first successful observation after B MUST enter E, never H.
Entering E MUST NOT reset accumulated failure history.
Any 429 while E MUST return to B.
H may be declared only after the configured confirmation-count and minimum-recovering-duration conditions are both satisfied.
Failure history may be reset only on E->H promotion.
This gate classifies recovery state; it does not authorize unsafe operation replay.
UNKNOWN operation outcomes remain governed by the existing re-observation rule.

confirmation_successes_required.note: Policy parameter. The repository does not claim a universal production value.

minimum_recovering_duration_s.note: Policy parameter. Lab fixtures are not production recommendations.
